title: Hot Spring Session Water Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hotspring:session water_temp_f=*
| stats sum(water_temp_f) as total_value, avg(water_temp_f) as avg_value by spa_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks spa values by total and average water temperature across Hot Spring session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `water_temp_f` values for each Hot Spring session event and review total and average water temperature by spa.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total water temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which spa shows the biggest water temperature numbers in your Hot Spring session data.
